nodes.name: session_crud.rs
nodes.summary: Core CRUD and state-transition operations for CLI agent sessions in SQLite -- creation, retrieval, listing, status/model/account updates, resume-state management, and deletion.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest persistence file; centralizes nearly all session lifecycle writes.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the core CLI agent session data model -- the persisted CodeSession row, its history-mutation record, and the parameters accepted when creating a new session.

nodes.name: worktree_state.rs
nodes.summary: Persists a CLI agent session's git worktree path/branch and merge status.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the Claude Code platform adapter; re-exports the oauth submodule.

nodes.name: oauth.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the Claude Code OAuth (PKCE) login flow: launching a webview, exchanging the authorization code for tokens, and fetching account/organization profile metadata.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the Codex platform adapter; re-exports the oauth submodule.

nodes.name: now_iso
nodes.summary: Returns the current UTC timestamp formatted as an RFC 3339 string.

nodes.name: sync_orgtrack_mirror
nodes.summary: Synchronizes a session's state to the org-tracking mirror table/service.

nodes.name: create_session
nodes.summary: Inserts a new CLI agent session row with the given creation parameters.

nodes.name: get_session
nodes.summary: Fetches a single CLI agent session by id.

nodes.name: list_sessions
nodes.summary: Lists all CLI agent sessions.

nodes.name: list_sessions_page
nodes.summary: Lists CLI agent sessions with pagination.

nodes.name: update_status
nodes.summary: Updates a session's status.

nodes.name: update_status_with_error
nodes.summary: Updates a session's status and records an associated error message.

nodes.name: update_pid
nodes.summary: Records the OS process id of a session's running CLI agent.

nodes.name: clear_pid
nodes.summary: Clears the recorded process id for a session once it has exited.

nodes.name: resume_profile_key
nodes.summary: Computes the profile key used to look up per-account CLI resume state.

nodes.name: update_cli_session_id
nodes.summary: Records the underlying CLI tool's own session id for resume purposes.

nodes.name: update_cli_session_id_for_account
nodes.summary: Records a per-account CLI resume session id, supporting multi-account resume.

nodes.name: session_persists_chunks
nodes.summary: Determines whether a session persists its transcript via managed chunks (vs. a native transcript source).

nodes.name: latest_native_transcript_id
nodes.summary: Fetches the most recently bound native transcript id for a session and source.

nodes.name: get_cli_session_id_for_account
nodes.summary: Fetches the CLI resume session id recorded for a specific account.

nodes.name: bump_history_mutation_with_tx
nodes.summary: Increments a session's history-mutation epoch within an existing transaction.

nodes.name: clear_cli_resume_state_with_tx
nodes.summary: Clears a session's CLI resume state within an existing transaction, recording the mutation reason.

nodes.name: clear_cli_resume_state
nodes.summary: Clears a session's CLI resume state (used when truncating history invalidates resumability).

nodes.name: get_history_mutation
nodes.summary: Fetches a session's current history-mutation record.

nodes.name: mapped_cli_session_id_for_account_with_conn
nodes.summary: Resolves the CLI resume session id mapped for an account using an explicit connection.

nodes.name: update_name
nodes.summary: Renames a session.

nodes.name: update_model_and_account
nodes.summary: Updates the model and account associated with a session.

nodes.name: update_agent_exec_mode
nodes.summary: Updates a session's agent execution mode (e.g. interactive vs. autonomous).

nodes.name: update_draft_text
nodes.summary: Persists an in-progress draft message for a session.

nodes.name: update_reply_target_event_id
nodes.summary: Sets the event id a session's next reply should be threaded under.

nodes.name: update_pinned
nodes.summary: Toggles whether a session is pinned.

nodes.name: update_proxy_credentials
nodes.summary: Updates a session's proxy authentication credentials.

nodes.name: delete_session
nodes.summary: Deletes a session and its associated persisted state.

nodes.name: sweep_stale_sessions
nodes.summary: Sweeps and cleans up sessions left in a stale/running state from a previous app run.

nodes.name: row_to_session
nodes.summary: Maps a SQLite row into a CodeSession domain struct.

nodes.name: update_worktree_info
nodes.summary: Records the git worktree path and branch information for a session.

nodes.name: update_merge_status
nodes.summary: Updates the recorded merge status of a session's worktree.

nodes.name: start_claude_code_oauth_login
nodes.summary: Begins a Claude Code OAuth login by generating PKCE parameters and the authorization URL.

nodes.name: exchange_claude_code_oauth_code
nodes.summary: Exchanges a Claude Code OAuth authorization code for access/refresh tokens after validating the state parameter.

nodes.name: create_claude_code_oauth_webview
nodes.summary: Creates an embedded webview to drive the Claude Code OAuth login (including Google SSO popup handling) and detect the callback URL.

nodes.name: close_claude_code_oauth_webview
nodes.summary: Closes the Claude Code OAuth login webview.

nodes.name: clear_claude_code_oauth_browser_session
nodes.summary: Clears the Claude Code OAuth webview's browser session/cookies to force a fresh login.

nodes.name: is_google_accounts_url
nodes.summary: Checks whether a URL belongs to Google's account/SSO domains.

nodes.name: is_claude_code_callback_url
nodes.summary: Checks whether a URL is the Claude Code OAuth callback URL.

nodes.name: is_google_gsi_transform_url
nodes.summary: Checks whether a URL is Google's GSI (Sign-In) transform/redirect URL.

nodes.name: random_base64url
nodes.summary: Generates a random base64url-encoded string of the given byte length, used for PKCE verifiers/state.

nodes.name: pkce_challenge
nodes.summary: Derives a PKCE code challenge (S256) from a code verifier.

nodes.name: build_authorize_url
nodes.summary: Builds the Claude Code OAuth authorization URL with the given state and PKCE challenge.

nodes.name: clean_authorization_code
nodes.summary: Strips extraneous characters/whitespace from a raw authorization code.

nodes.name: exchange_code_for_tokens
nodes.summary: Sends the token-exchange HTTP request to Claude Code's OAuth token endpoint.

nodes.name: fetch_claude_code_oauth_profile
nodes.summary: Fetches the authenticated user's Claude Code account/organization profile.

nodes.name: parse_claude_code_oauth_profile_response
nodes.summary: Parses the Claude Code profile endpoint's JSON response body.

nodes.name: normalize_metadata_field
nodes.summary: Normalizes an optional account-metadata string field, treating blanks as unset.

nodes.name: CodeSession
nodes.summary: Row type representing a persisted CLI agent session -- includes identity, status, runner/model/account, git worktree state, proxy credentials, org/project linkage, and timestamps.

nodes.name: CreateCodeSessionParams
nodes.summary: Parameters accepted when creating a new CLI agent session, covering agent selection, git repo/branch, isolation, and org/project context.
